Needs macOS 26 on an Apple silicon Mac with a built-in trackpad.

## Install

1. Download the zip below and open it.
2. Drag **Hand of Freedom** into your Applications folder.
3. Open it. The app isn't signed with an Apple developer certificate, so macOS refuses the first time and
   says it can't verify it. Close that message, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down
   and click **Open Anyway** next to Hand of Freedom.
4. The welcome window asks for **Accessibility**. Grant it, then switch to the game.

## Updating

Quit Hand of Freedom (menu bar hand icon › Quit) and replace the app in Applications.

macOS ties the Accessibility permission to the exact build, so after an update it still looks switched on but
does nothing. Open **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility**, select Hand of Freedom, remove it
with **−**, then open the app and grant it again.
